what: Decoder alone on the Mac GPU, the shipped fp16 bundle (S = 64): every fixture run (213 runs, 401 questions) with the oracle's ids and fp32 image rows, the fp16 hidden read through the author's fp32 head, against the author's fp32 readout. Merged from two invocations (round 3: 80 runs, round 4: the other 133). export_record = the export_decoder.py run that wrote the bundle.

removed: runs[].call_ms (per-call ms; the timing block keeps the medians)
runs[].hidden.lowest_positions (each run keeps min_pos_cos, its index and the counts below 0.99 / 0.9 / 0.5)
runs[].questions[].probs_oracle (the oracle's probabilities are in fixtures-clef-flash.json)
oracle.npz_sha256 (sha256 of the lane's per-run oracle npz files)
processes[].npz / npz_sha256 / descriptor (the descriptor is the top-level one: descriptor_same_in_every_process)
compare_with.rows (per-run comparison rows; the compare_with summary stays)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_clefflash/ (not in the repository)

environment.runtime: coreai python runtime, AOT h16c GPU .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default(), no JIT
environment.head: the author's JointSchemaHead, fp32, CPU (parity_decoder_torch.AuthorHead)
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, no _GPU_LOCK held (times are contended reference values)

other_gpu_processes.note: process listing removed before publication (5 lines); it showed other sessions' GPU work at the time = the times are contended

environment.head: the author's JointSchemaHead, fp32, CPU (parity_decoder_torch.AuthorHead)

readout.merge_rule: every run entry as its invocation scored it (+ invocation, + npz; position-cosine counts added from the run's own npz where the invocation predates them); summary, checks, per-group tables and timing recomputed over the union
readout.gate: decoder alone on the Mac GPU (oracle ids, oracle fp32 image_embeds -> fp16, zero-padded to 1024 rows), the fp16 hidden read through the author's fp32 head
readout.readout: fresh zero states; a row of T ids runs as ceil(T / 64) calls of 'main' (static S = 64): call k gets ids[64k : 64k + 64] with position_ids 0..64k+63; the last call is padded with <|endoftext|> (248044) and the hidden rows of the padded positions are discarded (causal: they cannot reach a real position). The hidden rows [1, 64, 4096] of every call, concatenated and cut to T, are the backbone's final-norm last_hidden_state [T, 4096] the head reads.

skipped.reason: N = 40 x 30 = 1,200 image rows > the graph's 1024-row buffer (outside the fixed-grid path), not run

bar.argmax: every question with an oracle top-2 margin above 0.02; near-ties listed apart
bar.max_abs_dp_applies_to: every option of every question, near-ties included
bar.reset: bit-equal hidden rows in every process
bar.mean_of_run_mean_abs_dp_definition: mean over runs of the mean |dp| over all (question, option) entries of the run

red_arm.arm: image_embeds zeroed (ids, image_rc and the rope shift unchanged)

readout.note: round 4 step 1: fp16 pf64 on all 213 runs = round 3's 80-run invocation (s64, AOT tree e8eed8db) + round 4's 133-run invocation (s64rest, re-AOT tree 86d0a881; compiled graph files byte-identical, only metadata.json creationDate and stats.json differ)
